test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the name of famous petroleum site located in Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ankleshwar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ankleshwar**

 
 
• **Ankleshwar **is the largest and most famous **petroleum site **located in the **Bharuch district of Gujarat, India**.
 
• The Ankleshwar field, located roughly **80 km south of Vadodara and nearly 160 km south of Khambhat**, was the first significant oil find and was made in** 1958**.
 
• The **anticline at Ankleshwar** is** 4 km **wide and** 20 km **long. 
 
• Oil can be found between** 1000 and 1200 metres** below the surface.
 
• It is such a productive oilfield that **Jawaharlal Nehru, India's former prime leader, referred to it as the fountain of prosperity**. 
 
• This field has the potential to produce** 2,500,000 million tonnes** of oil annually. 
 
• The refineries in **Trombay and Koyali** receive oil from this field.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Oil and Gas Industry**

 
 
• The** discovery of the nation's first oil resources** in the town of** Digboi in the state of Assam in 1889 **marked the beginning of India's oil and gas sector.
 
• After the discovery of gas fields in **Assam and Gujarat**, the natural gas industry in India got its start in the **1960s**.
 
• **Gujarat** is home to** 4% **of India's estimated** total natural gas reserves **and** 20% **of the country's projected **total crude oil reserves**.
 
• The** largest oil field in India**, known as** Bombay High, **is situated at the coast of Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• The** first refinery** in India's public sector is the **Guwahati Refinery**.
 
• The** largest refinery in the world at present is the Jamnagar Refinery** in India, which is owned and run by** Reliance Industry**.
